create_swin_transformer_model: create a SwinTransformer model with configurable depth, num_heads, embed_dim, and window_size
build_swin_transformer_trunk: build a SwinTransformerOfficialTrunk from a VISSL AttrDict model configuration
partition_image_into_windows: partition an image tensor into non-overlapping windows for windowed self-attention
reverse_window_partition: reverse a window-partitioned tensor back to the original image tensor layout
compute_model_flops: compute the total FLOPs of a SwinTransformer model including all layers and embeddings
